name: ToggleGroup
description: Groups `Toggle` buttons so they share a pressed state, letting one or, with `multiple`, several be pressed at a time. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the toggles in the group, controlling their height and width. A `Toggle` that sets its own `size` keeps it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The pressed state of the toggle group represented by an array of
the values of all pressed toggle buttons.
This is the uncontrolled counterpart of `value`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback fired when the pressed states of the toggle group changes.

props.name: value
props.description:
The pressed state of the toggle group represented by an array of
the values of all pressed toggle buttons.
This is the controlled counterpart of `defaultValue`.

props.name: children
props.description: Toggles shown in the group, such as `Toggle` buttons.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of keyboard navigation between the toggles: Left and Right arrow keys for `horizontal`, Up and Down arrow keys for `vertical`. Doesn't change the layout.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the toggle group should ignore user interaction.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description:
Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the first item
when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys.

props.name: multiple
props.description:
When `false` only one item in the group can be pressed. If any item in
the group becomes pressed, the others will become unpressed.
When `true` multiple items can be pressed.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: ToggleGroup.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
